text:
Type: cat print eyelet curtains, pair
Use: dimming light and adding privacy at a window; children's room, bedroom, playroom
Style: Scandinavian, retro, contemporary
Materials: printed cotton fabric, metal eyelet heading
Colors: black, white
Shape: two full-length straight panels covered in a repeating pattern of stylized black cat faces with white whiskers, eyelet top, even folds, bold graphic look
Feel: playful, graphic, bold, quirky
Goes with: white walls, black accents, light wood, bright solid bedding; Scandinavian or modern kids' rooms

product.name: MATTRAM
product.description: The curtains lower the general light level and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing directly into the room.
